race.comment: Good race with several chances but keen to stick with SQUARE DEAL (1) who continues to race well. Echuca winner two back then stormed home from well back for a close-up fourth latest. Looks tough to stop again. ATAEGINA (4) was a near miss two back then safely held at Flemington last time. This far more suitable and gets chance to immediately bounce back. INFINITE JEST (3) is close to a win, placing the latest here behind Red On red. Loves the wet and will give a sight. COUNT OF TOULOUSE (2) ran on hard to score last time and will wind up late again. SETHEUS (9) is fitter for the extra ground and worth including.
